title: Reload a placed component from its source SchLib
summary: Swaps a placed schematic component for a fresh copy loaded with LoadComponentFromLibrary, from a right-click menu item, keeping position, part, orientation and unique ID; shows the robot-manager bracket and that the copy carries the library symbol's own SourceLibraryName.
phrasings: update a schematic part from the library
replace a component with the latest symbol
add an item to the schematic right-click menu
find the component under the cursor

commands.name: UpdateComponentFromSchLib
commands.description: Reload a placed component from its source SchLib
commands.params: Designator=<x> (optional; else the right-click hit, else the one selected component)|LibraryFolders=<folder;folder> (optional)|KeepUniqueId=false (optional)

commands.name: ComponentInfo
commands.description: Report a placed component's library, part, location and unique ID (test helper)
